title: A Context-Aware Contrastive Learning Framework for Hateful Meme Detection and Segmentation
findings: Models displayed moderate performance for memes containing religious hate. The proposed HATESIEVE model achieved 73.08% classification accuracy and 76.92% segmentation accuracy for the 'Religion' category. The authors conclude that this highlights a need for more diverse training data and targeted refinement to improve performance on religious hate content.
